unmapped_files.why: PCGR's per-tumour report, annotated and PASS VCFs, MAF, tier, TMB, MSI, signature and CNA tables, named <patient>.<sample> (PCGR_RUN ext.prefix). The harvest cannot attribute that name to the samplesheet's sample, so no per-sample row can find them; see the README, variantprioritization.

CPSR's per-germline-VCF report, classification and PASS tables and VCFs, named <patient>.<sample> (CPSR_RUN ext.prefix), which the harvest cannot attribute to a samplesheet sample; see the README, variantprioritization.

Caller VCFs reformatted for PCGR, the caller-support keys, the merged PCGR-ready VCF and the allele-specific CNA table (REFORMAT_VCF, INTERSECT_VCF, PCGR_PREPAREVCF, REFORMAT_CNA): inputs PCGR builds its own results from.
Each input VCF left-normalised (bcftools norm) and depth-filtered (bcftools filter): working copies of call sets registered elsewhere, not new ones.
Tabix indexes made for input VCFs that came without one: indexes of files outside this run.
MultiQC here lists only software versions and citations (no QC module reads VCFs in 1.0.0), and the run's parents are A.VCF rows, so there is no D.SEQ to carry Link_QC.
The PCGR reference bundle and VEP cache, unpacked or downloaded (PCGR_GETREF, UNTAR_PCGR_DB, UNTAR_VEP_CACHE): reference files, not sample data.
